round1Body:
<!-- ugcportal-review-round: 1 -->
**Review round 1 (chain `approx`, head `d040d1d9fb1c62a70d506c84924493a6be943fb9`) — approved, merging.** CI green (5/5), no sensitive paths touched, no blocking findings.

Posted as a comment rather than via `gh pr review --approve`: GitHub rejects that with *"Can not approve your own pull request"*, because the reviewing account (`eiriksf-capgemini`) is also the PR's author. That same identity collision is why the chain is `approx` — self-asserted (`pr-review-merge` step 4b). Round 1 is in the strict 1-3 band regardless, so `approx` changes nothing here: any finding at any severity would have blocked, and the PR merges only on zero findings. The bootstrap probe returned 0 prior review activity before this run and there are no prior markers, so this is a genuinely fresh round 1, not a bootstrap.

**`code-review`** (forked, effort=high, `121 high --comment`): 0 findings (`[]`). Verified `isGenuinelyEmptyPage`'s body is byte-identical to the inline expression it replaces, matching parameter types, 88/88 relevant tests green.

**Required recurring-family sweep (step 4.1 / review-standards section 2) — all four checked, independently verified in a scratch worktree (`/tmp/review-121`, head d040d1d, `npm ci && npx prisma generate`):**

- **Family 1 (a comment claims a guarantee the code does not make): checked, nothing found.** `claims-audit.mjs` (default, added-lines mode) reports 18 candidates (ABSOLUTE 14, TEMPORAL 3, HISTORY 4, REFERENCE 0) — matches the PR body's own figure exactly. Read all 18: each is an accurate disclaimer, not an overclaim. Verified by hand: page.tsx's early-return-or-render-`<Gallery>` structure means the two `isGenuinelyEmptyPage` calls can only disagree when `toGalleryItems` filtering drops a row, or the feed's own `hasMore`/cursor disagree with each other — exactly, and only, what the docstring in `gallery-items.ts` and the PR body both claim.
- **Family 2 (a check compares the wrong two things): checked, nothing found.** No new comparison is introduced; the diff replaces an inline boolean expression with a call to the pre-existing helper of identical body (`items.length === 0 && !hasMore`), confirmed by reading `gallery-items.ts:312`. No NaN/null-input path applies — `items`/`hasMore` are well-typed, not user input parsed at this boundary.
- **Family 3 (an assertion that cannot fail): checked via live mutation, not just reasoning.** (a) Reverted `gallery.tsx`'s call back to the inline `items.length === 0 && !hasMore` expression — the new source-grep assertion (`gallery.test.tsx:401-402`, anchored via `readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("./gallery.tsx", import.meta.url)))`) failed as expected, so it is not vacuous. (b) Mutated `isGenuinelyEmptyPage` to `items.length === 0` alone (dropping `hasMore`) — 3 tests failed, including the new table's `hasMore=true`/empty-items row, confirming the table discriminates against exactly the weaker implementation the bead's K2 names. Both mutations reverted; full suite green again (107/107 across the three touched test files).
- **Family 4 (sibling-omission): checked, nothing found.** This PR's whole point is closing a family-4 gap (gallery.tsx's inline copy vs. page.tsx's call to the shared helper). Repo-wide grep for `items.length === 0` and `isGenuinelyEmptyPage`/`genuinely empty` found no other untouched sibling — the two other string matches (`gallery-unavailable.tsx`, `page.error.test.tsx`) are unrelated rendered UI copy ("the gallery is genuinely empty" as user-facing text), not this implementation gap, matching what the PR body says. Confirmed the helper's docstring in `gallery-items.ts` says exactly what the PR body claims (page.tsx's and gallery.tsx's inputs still differ by design; only unhealthy data can make the two callers disagree) and nothing stronger — same wording independently cross-checked against `bd show ugcportal-3wcd`'s in/out-of-scope text, which matches both the PR body and the shipped diff.

Also independently reran `sweep-candidates.mjs` (40 `toContain` candidates, 0 sibling candidates — matches PR body) and `npx vitest run` on the three touched test files (107/107 passing).

No findings to defer; no beads filed.
